text:
Aisha: Quick idea 12:30 short 5k loop from the office, easy pace. Who's in?
Tom: Love this. I can lead an easy/moderate group. Will be ~5.2k if we take the riverside detour.
Ravi: In! Can someone save me a pair of heel grips? My inserts are at home.
Jules: I can bring spare grips and Bandaid kit. Also I vote post-run smoothie station. :tropical_drink:
Aisha: Perfect. Smoothie vote  banana-protein or green-spinach?
Tom: Banana-protein hands down. Green makes me sleepy. :sleeping:
SnackBot: Poll created: Banana-protein (3) vs Green-spinach (1). Order will be placed 12:55.
Ravi: ETA back by 1:10? I have a 1:30 sync but can shower quick.
Marta: Heads up, theres a small puddle by the 3rd bridge after yesterdays rain. Recommend shoes with decent tread.
Jules: Noted. Route note: we can detour via bench by the coffee kiosk if ppl want a slower cooldown walk.
Tom: Pace groups: 6:00/km brisk, 7:00/km easy. Which do you want?
Aisha: Easy please. Im recovering from a long run Sunday.
Ravi: Brisk for me if someone to pace me on the uphill.
Jules: Ill stay between groups and carry the Bandaid kit.
SnackBot: Smoothie order: 4x Banana-protein. Pickup scheduled 13:00 from Canopy Cafe.
Tom: Meetup: lobby stairs 12:25 so we can stretch and head out at 12:30. Bring a water bottle.
Aisha: Also: if anyone wants to swap a pair of running socks, I have an extra merino pair size M.
Marta: Can I grab those? I forgot mine.
Aisha: DM me and Ill leave them by the reception.
Ravi: Quick timing question: will returning by 1:10 include time to pick up smoothie?
Jules: We can send one runner to grab them if were running late. Tom, want to do a smoothie-sherpa?
Tom: I can do it if needed. Otherwise SnackBot will hold the order.
Aisha: OK team see you at the stairs. Rain plan: if its pouring we postpone to tomorrow noon.
SnackBot: Weather check @12:05: 10% chance of rain. All systems go. :sun_with_face:
